predecessors.name: Hemudu culture
predecessors.text: Hemudu, "22 km northwest of Ningbo", Yuyao "just south of the Hangzhou Bay in Jiangnan", and "the islands of Zhoushan"

ledger.x: 3300 BCE: the Liangzhu culture succeeds the Songze around Lake Tai ("3300-2300 BC"; "Preceded by: Songze culture and Hemudu culture").
3300 BCE: the Liangzhu core at Hangzhou, beyond the Songze country, where the walled city rises (Liangzhu ancient city, Mojiaoshan, Yuhang).
3300 BCE: the Ningbo plain, the Hemudu country, falls to the Liangzhu, which lists the Hemudu as a predecessor.
2300 BCE: the Liangzhu disappears from the Taihu Lake area: "The Liangzhu culture flourished around 2500 BC, but disappeared from the Taihu Lake area after around 2300 BC."

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the dam system and walls fix the city, not the culture area.
